linkage_record.notes: SDY1264 is mapped to GEO SuperSeries GSE13486. GSE13485 contains the YF-17D vaccinee expression series.

appropriate_timepoints.evidence: Both baseline/pre-vaccination and post-vaccination timepoints are represented in GEO metadata. | Early transcriptomic measurements at days [0, 1, 3, 7] are linked to later quantitative CD8 measurements at days [15].
appropriate_timepoints.fusion_note: At least one source positively establishes this criterion and no source contradicts it.

eif2ak4_measurable.evidence: EIF2AK4 is represented by feature Hs.412102_at in the GEO platform annotation and the same feature has numeric expression values in the downloaded series matrix. | Transcriptomic predictor data are available and linked to GEO, but EIF2AK4/GCN2 feature coverage has not yet been verified directly from the GEO platform or expression matrix.
eif2ak4_measurable.fusion_note: At least one source positively establishes this criterion and no source contradicts it.

human_study.evidence: Human study terminology detected in GEO metadata. | 112 parsed ImmPort experimental-sample rows are annotated as Homo sapiens.
human_study.fusion_note: At least one source positively establishes this criterion and no source contradicts it.

outcome_data_accessible.evidence: Exact participant-level quantitative CD8 outcome values have not yet been verified in GEO. A linked source such as ImmPort may provide complementary immune phenotype data. | 25 numeric CD8 outcome values are directly available in ImmPort lab_test.txt and all map to participant biosamples.
outcome_data_accessible.fusion_note: At least one source positively establishes this criterion and no source contradicts it.

participant_level_linkage.evidence: GEO samples may contain subject identifiers, but participant-level linkage between transcriptomic predictor and quantitative immune outcome must be verified explicitly. | All 25 subjects with quantitative CD8 outcomes also have early transcriptomic measurements; overlap=25 subjects.
participant_level_linkage.fusion_note: At least one source positively establishes this criterion and no source contradicts it.

predictor_data_accessible.evidence: GEO transcriptomic data are represented in the study metadata. | Transcriptomic samples are linked to 87 GEO GSM accessions.
predictor_data_accessible.fusion_note: At least one source positively establishes this criterion and no source contradicts it.

quantitative_cd8_response_available.evidence: CD8 terminology is present, but the exact quantitative CD8 response endpoint has not been established. | 25 participant-level quantitative CD8 response measurements with numeric values were found in ImmPort lab_test.txt.
quantitative_cd8_response_available.fusion_note: At least one source positively establishes this criterion and no source contradicts it.

transcriptomics_available.evidence: Transcriptomic/gene-expression assay detected in GEO metadata. | 87 transcriptomic experimental samples were identified in the parsed ImmPort manifest.
transcriptomics_available.fusion_note: At least one source positively establishes this criterion and no source contradicts it.

yf17d_vaccination.evidence: YF-17D/yellow fever vaccination terminology detected. | YF17D/yellow-fever terminology is present in the ImmPort experiment metadata.
yf17d_vaccination.fusion_note: At least one source positively establishes this criterion and no source contradicts it.

fusion_notes: Evidence was fused only after the supplied accessions matched a verified cross-repository linkage record.
A GEO subseries may be used when that subseries is explicitly listed under the linked GEO SuperSeries.
Positive evidence can resolve an unknown criterion, but explicit contradictory evidence creates a conflict that remains unresolved.
Cross-repository evidence fusion does not itself prove participant-level predictor/outcome linkage.
